page.layout: Running head top centre-left "NVPTIALES." with page number "101" top right; one column of text, continued from the previous page; centred heading "CONCIO XII" with "Genef. 28." below it; then one column of text with a decorative woodcut initial at the start; no marginal notes; printed "G 3" signature at the foot.

main_text.p: benedicit Isaaco: qui quidem seuit & laborauit, sed à Domino benedictionem expecta-vit, atque accepit tantam, ut & Palæstinos ad inuidiam moueret, & regem illorum ad odium: id quod Isaacus patienter tulit. Omnes igitur sperent, non in principibus, sed in solo Deo: qui suos semper cruce probat, sed ab ea tandem liberat: cui debetur honor, gloria & potestas in secula seculorum, Amen.
main_text.head: CONCIO XII
Genef. 28.

p.i: Vocauit itaque Isahac Iacob, & benedixit eum: præcepitq; ei, et dixit ad eum: non accipies uxorem de filiabus Chanaan. Surge, vade in Mesopotamiam, ad domũ Bethuel patris matris tuæ, & sume tibi inde uxorẽ de filiabus Laban fratris matris tuæ. Deus autem omnipotens benedicat tibi, & faciat te crescere, atque multiplicet te, ut sis in congregationem populorum. Det quoque tibi benedictionem Abraham, tibi & semini tuo tecum, ut in hæreditatem accipias terram peregrinationum tuarum, quam dedit Deus Abraham. page.notes: The ornamental sign before "Abraham" in the line "benedictionem / Abraham" is not clearly a letter; left out as decoration. The woodcut initial V is joined to "ocauit" as "Vocauit". Printed "Ifaaco", "Ifaacus" and "Ifahac" are copied with long s as "Isaaco", "Isaacus" and "Isahac"; "Isahac" in the italic paragraph is copied as printed. The running head "NVPTIALES." is printed as NUPTIALES. The page number "101" is partly blurred at the top right and may be read as "ror" in the scan; checked as 101.
